mechanics: Melee troops, including Ironclad and Frost Fang, stop moving once their enemy is within melee attack range, even if that enemy continues moving inside the range.
Troops resume chasing when their target leaves attack range, then stop again when they catch it. Attack ranges and attack intervals are unchanged.
Existing friendly yielding, opposing collision, swarm contact spacing and tower approach behavior are preserved.

All 21 playable cards and the subordinate skeleton retain their 1.8.0 numerical stats, abilities, collision radii and model scales. Models, animation assets, audio, interface and arena geometry are unchanged.
Navigation revision advances from 10 to 11 so new Meta simulations use the corrected melee movement. Historical replays and recorded results retain their original identities.
derivedMetrics: Basic DPS = damage / attack interval. Group DPS assumes continuous attacks by every member. Travel, charge, aura, splash target count, shield and death summons are separate.
